limitations: Declared actor/operator/wallet labels are fixtures, not authentication.
No LLM agent runtime, blockchain verification, signer, fee accounting or live service.
Unpaid reservations can starve legitimate work.
Delivery digests and acknowledgments do not establish useful output or quality.
Synthetic quote-bound receipt admission cannot replace a complete chain observation ledger.
Timing samples include CLI processes and report I/O; they are not live throughput or an SLA.
HTML export is editable and unsigned; source JSON requires Rust replay verification.

post_source_candidate_finding.remediation: Wait for normal child shutdown or bounded kill fallback; use documented fs.rm maxRetries=10/retryDelay=100. Persistent cleanup errors remain failures.
